match: ^a lasting block rule reading what its ability chose$
needs: A `LastingBlockRule` holds a plain function, so it can't read the color or player a resolving ability chose; it needs that value carried with the effect.

match: ^a cost at resolution filtered by who is asked to pay it$
needs: A cost built at resolution filters with plain functions, so it can't read the player found as it resolves; `Asker` needs the payer.
api: Asker::payer(), read by the cost's filter
